name: Fetch MCP Server
description: Enables LLMs to fetch and process web content by converting HTML into markdown for easier consumption. It supports chunked reading via pagination and provides configuration options for robots.txt compliance and proxy usage.

rawRecord.description: Enables LLMs to fetch and process web content by converting HTML into markdown for easier consumption. It supports chunked reading via pagination and provides configuration options for robots.txt compliance and proxy usage.

proxy-url.description: The server can be configured to use a proxy by using the --proxy-url argument.

user-agent.description: Customizes the user-agent. This can be customized by adding the argument --user-agent=YourUserAgent to the args list in the configuration.

ignore-robots-txt.description: By default, the server will obey a websites robots.txt file if the request came from the model (via a tool), but not if the request was user initiated (via a prompt). This can be disabled by adding the argument --ignore-robots-txt to the args list in the configuration.
